name: NitroFusionValidate
description: Validates a Fusion configuration composition against the Nitro registry.
author: ChilliCream

inputs.name: authenticationType
inputs.label: Authentication
inputs.helpMarkDown: How to authenticate against the Nitro registry. Choose 'Nitro service connection' to reuse a centrally-configured connection.

inputs.name: nitroServiceConnection
inputs.label: Nitro service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Service connection that supplies the API key and (optionally) the Nitro cloud URL.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: API key
inputs.helpMarkDown: API key for authentication. Use a secret pipeline variable: `$(NITRO_API_KEY)`.

inputs.name: sourceSchemaFiles
inputs.label: Source schema files
inputs.helpMarkDown: Paths to source schema files (one per line).

inputs.name: legacyV1Archive
inputs.label: Legacy v1 archive
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to a Fusion v1 archive file.

inputs.name: cloudUrl
inputs.label: Cloud URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: The URL of the Nitro registry. Only used when authenticating with an API key; when using a service connection, the URL is taken from the connection.
